description_en: Retrieves the list of HpnZones for a file system. Access performance is optimal when compute nodes are located in one of the associated HpnZones
description_zh: 查询文件系统关联的 HpnZone 列表，当计算节点位于关联的 HpnZone 中时，访问文件系统的性能最优
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-filesystems-associated-hpn-zones --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --filesystems FileSystemId=bmcpfs-290t15yn4uo8lid0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeFilesystemsAssociatedHpnZones

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the file system resides
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the CPFS for Lingjun file system. Must start with `bmcpfs-`. Example: bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya\\
fields.help_zh: CPFS智算版文件系统ID。必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
fields.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The collection of file system IDs.

The maximum number of elements in the set must be less than or equal to 20
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID集合。
集合中最大元素数量需小于或等于20
parameters.name: filesystems

Filesystems.description_en: The list of HpnZones associated with the file system

items.description_en: The HpnZone associated with the file system

AssociatedHpnZones.description_en: The list of HpnZones supported by the file system
